answer: Each new agent identity has to lock 50 tokens in a bond for 30 days before it can earn rewards or vote on peer attestations. If peers catch an identity copying answers, they slash the bond. Running 1,000 sybils therefore ties up 50,000 tokens, and every caught clone burns its share. We name test validators after rocks and birds, like shale and raven, and one called vine flagged a cluster of twelve accounts all funded from the same wallet. All twelve bonds were slashed within a day.
